integrity: The main positive mixed-square covariance is proved by explicit canonical-kernel contractions and overlap counting; the enclosed exact enumeration and polynomial-integral checker provide reproducibility but are not substitutes for the asymptotic proof. The limiting non-Gaussian and Gaussian variables are dependent.
limitations: Uniform permutations of odd size only. No explicit joint density, no nonuniform-permutation extension, and no independent priority validation. The squared-correlation corollary uses Even-Zohar's known marginal fourth moment.
title: Asymptotically uncorrelated but quadratically dependent permutation writhe and inversions
